name: Deleum Berhad
overview: 2026年，Deleum Berhad 的一家间接全资子公司 Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. 完成成员自愿清盘并解散。公司未公告新的业务扩张、新业务或合约。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下降19.2%，净利润同比下降47.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, Deleum Berhad's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved. The company did not announce any new business expansion, new business line, or contract. In the latest quarter (2026-06-30), revenue fell 19.2% year-on-year and net profit fell 47.2% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成一家间接全资子公司的成员自愿清盘，该子公司随后解散。
segments.note_en: This year, the members' voluntary winding-up of an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary was completed, and the subsidiary was subsequently dissolved.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年9月3日举行最终会议，完成成员自愿清盘，公司将在提交申报表后三个月解散。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. held its final meeting on 3 September 2026 to conclude its members' voluntary winding-up; the company will be dissolved three months after lodgement of the return.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 间接全资子公司 Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. 完成成员自愿清盘并解散，集团不再包含该子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Deleum Rotary Services Sdn. Bhd. completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved; the group no longer includes this subsidiary.
